observable_parameter_oracle.subtraction_rule: only the empirical field may be subtracted from an empirical estimator error; the analytic field is a property of the world and differs systematically (0.628582 vs 0.652515 on the v0.2 validation seeds, a 0.023933 gap larger than the 0.02 threshold itself)

true_actor_oracle.reason: no actor evidence exists on unobserved steps

reachability_references.put_back_reference_gap: the put-back target IS the mode of the habit distribution, so a parameter oracle scores zero by construction and its headroom bound is vacuous. The put-back pass is therefore still protected only from below. A visible-history reachability reference for put-back is REQUIRED before the put-back criteria can be called symmetric.

true_change_point_variant.reason: it reads evaluator truth; it may bound the room left for a change-point operator but may never participate in method_comparison_allowed

regime_adaptive_witness.purpose: minimal executable learnability witness, not a strong baseline
regime_adaptive_witness.detector: two-window total-variation test, centred under the null

superseded_detector.defect: not centred: a stable habit has mode mass 0.42-0.58, so the mispredict rate already exceeds any usable drift allowance and the statistic climbs with elapsed time. It resets on a schedule, so its reset count carried no evidence about detection and the 0.016602 gain it produced must not be read as adaptivity.

train_results_with_false_reset_constrain.constraint: false resets per rollout <= 1.0 (a reset outside 14 days after a true change)

regime_adaptive_witness.reading: gain rises with reset frequency and most extra resets are false, so the benefit is 'forget old data often', not 'detect the change'. Constrained to a credible false reset rate the witness reaches 0.009227 on train, far below 0.02.

contribution_safety_check.question: does the witness absorb the benefit a change-point operator would claim
contribution_safety_check.reading: the minimal CUSUM captures 55% of the top-1 gain and 83% of the path-cost gain that perfect detection provides; the top-1 gap it leaves (0.013744) is 83% of the witness's own gain and comparable to the entire rolling-count family ceiling (0.015831), so the witness does not foreclose a change-point contribution

reported_but_not_binding: search normalised path cost for every rule

horizon_probe.status: train-only design probe on fresh seeds; not a gate, no method involved
horizon_probe.question: is 0.02 unreachable because the detector is weak or because the world is too short
horizon_probe.reading: the frozen v0.2 horizon yields about 37.5 observed owner placements over three regimes and two calendar contexts, roughly six per cell. CORRECTED: this is not an information-theoretic impossibility. Method-free sampling from the frozen train worlds' own habit distributions recovers the true mode from six samples 74.8% of the time (3 -> 0.583, 6 -> 0.748, 10 -> 0.836, 13 -> 0.873, 20 -> 0.919). The supportable claim is only that the current horizon is not enough for the false-alarm-constrained TV witness to reach 0.02 reliably.
horizon_probe.lever_note: raising base_observation_probability would also add samples but would weaken the selective-observation claim the paper rests on; lengthening the horizon does not

tie_break_correction.finding: three different tie-breaks were in use: the formal evaluator ranks by encounter order (position in the episode's location tuple), while the v0.2 gate and the first v0.3 draft both ranked lexicographically by location string. Locations are hex suffixed, so the two orders differ, and with integer counts and zero shrinkage ties are frequent.

recomputation_under_the_formal_tie_break.note: diagnostic recomputation on the v0.2 validation seeds; the v0.2 artifact and verdict are archived unchanged and are not superseded

tie_break_correction.consequence: the search verdict direction is unchanged (0.015201 is still below 0.02), but the put-back level moves by 0.021898, which is larger than the search shift. The v0.2 put-back criteria PASSED under the non-formal tie-break, so the put-back aggregation and context gains must be re-measured under the formal rule before any v0.3 criterion is written; a pass must not be inherited unexamined.

gate_path.estimator: plain window + shrinkage rolling estimator; no change detector
gate_path.witness_status: retained in code and in the xfail test so its failure stays reproducible, but removed from the Gate A decision path
gate_path.what_this_does_not_mean: dropping the detector from the gate is not a statement about CF-BOCPD. When method comparison resumes, a change-point operator must still beat fixed-window, multi-window and simple change-detector baselines.
